summary: Fold Holdings filed an 8-K announcing termination of its Equity Purchase Facility Agreement with an unnamed investor. The facility, dated June 16, 2025, allowed the company to sell up to $250 million of newly issued common stock at its discretion. No advances were outstanding at termination, effective September 3, 2026. No prepayment fees or penalties were incurred. The related registration rights agreement also terminates, except for any shares still held. The termination leaves alternative financing options open and has no immediate impact on shareholders.
